scientific_integrity: The cardinality polynomial and exceptional-order claim are supported by an exact finite-state transfer proof and direct independent exhaustive small-order checks. Earlier unrestricted [1,2]-domination and independent-domination results are acknowledged; no priority guarantee or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For generalized Petersen P(n,2) and n>=5 only. Weighted transfer determinant is an exact finite computation; full reproducible code is supplied. Earlier equivalent literature under alternative terminology remains possible. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Independent \([1,2]\)-dominating sets of generalized Petersen graphs: an exact polynomial and a missing order
